preconditions.description: The number of elements in array a is between 1 and 200,000.
Each element in array a is between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: Each element in the output array d is either a non-negative number or -1, indicating the minimum number of moves or impossibility of reaching a position with opposite parity.

postconditions.expression: all(d_i == -1 or (1 <= i <= n and (a_i % 2 != a_j % 2 implies d_i <= d_j)))
postconditions.description: For each position i, if there exists a position j with opposite parity such that d_i is not -1, then d_i must be less than or equal to d_j.
